ev.q: Analysis of data from four vaccine effectiveness (VE) networks estimated interim pediatric influenza VE
Among pediatric patients, the proportion of vaccinated control patients within the VE networks ranged from 25% to 31%
Among pediatric patients, the proportion of vaccinated control patients within the VE networks ranged from 25% to 31%
Control patients were those with ARI who received a negative influenza molecular assay test result.
Logistic regression models were adjusted for geographic region, age, calendar time of illness
using a test-negative case-control study design

methods_quotes.q: Influenza VE was estimated based on a test-negative case-control design using multivariable logistic regression as (1 – adjusted odds ratio) × 100%.
VE was reported in the text as a range, from lowest VE point estimate to highest, without CIs.
Logistic regression models were adjusted for geographic region, age, calendar time of illness
Firth logistic regression was used for NVSN’s inpatient estimates.
